baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence أَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ joins an outward action on everything inside to a resulting state of emptiness.
baseline_models.mechanism: A containing subject discharges its whole interior and then reaches zero remainder. The second verb is not redundant: it verifies that the casting completed the evacuation.

activation_trace.role: Casting moves held material outward and supplies the active discharge stage.
Bare emptiness supplies the terminal state and makes the discharge exhaustive.

changed_reading.after: The subject performs a two-stage total evacuation: everything internal is cast out, then its vacancy is complete.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object مَا فِيهَا is first cast into an exterior relation and the subject then تَخَلَّتْ, a form compatible with letting go.
baseline_models.mechanism: The event can be read as transfer rather than dumping. Contents are put where they can be met, after which the former holder releases custody and no longer stands between them and what follows.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face arrival turns outward casting into placement before a coming encounter.
Letting go supplies the holder's relinquishment after the contents have been placed outside.

changed_reading.before: The contents are discarded as refuse.
changed_reading.after: The contents are handed into an exterior encounter and the container relinquishes custody of them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Total externalization of مَا فِيهَا is followed by a root branch in تَخَلَّتْ that can picture being clear of liability.
baseline_models.mechanism: The container cannot be clear while anything remains concealed within it. Rendering up the whole deposit is therefore the operation by which it exits its charge.

activation_trace.role: Casting makes the held deposit externally available rather than privately retained.
Clearance from liability supplies a juridical consequence for complete surrender of the deposit.

changed_reading.before: Emptying is only a change in volume.
changed_reading.after: Emptying is also discharge of a charge: the holder renders up all that was entrusted to its interior and stands clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus becomes the lower half of a coordinated cosmic opening. The upper enclosure splits; the lower expanse is pulled long; the latter then unloads its interior and lies bare.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the lower enclosure's outward unloading.
Bareness supplies the exposed condition reached after unloading.
The overhead enclosure establishes the upper member of the paired spatial system.
Splitting and opening supply the first loss of cosmic containment.
The lower counterpart to the sky identifies the focus subject as the terrestrial enclosure.
Lengthwise pulling supplies the deformation that removes the earth's former containing shape.

structural_cues: 84:1 and 84:3 present upper and lower cosmic subjects in parallel إذا clauses before the focus completes the lower sequence.
The focus preserves process order: deformation, outward discharge, then bareness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rupture above, extension below, and total emptying; I infer that the deformations undo enclosure and enable exposure. A live alternative is coordinated obedience without a physical causal arrow between stretching and expulsion.

changed_reading.after: The stretched lower cosmic envelope unloads and bares itself as the spatial counterpart of the split upper envelope.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical response formula around the terrestrial sequence recodes ejection as heard, accepted, and due performance. The subject does not merely lose its contents; it yields them to its governing claimant because that response fits what is owed.

activation_trace.role: Casting is the concrete act through which the accepted demand is carried out.
Letting go gives the response the character of unresisting surrender.
Listening with acceptance supplies responsive agency rather than accidental collapse.
Lordship supplies the governing relation to which the cosmic subject responds.
Fixed obligation makes the response fitting and owed, not optional.
The repeated acceptance closes the earth sequence and brackets the focus as fulfilled response.

structural_cues: The same feminine response clause occurs at 84:2 and 84:5, enclosing the earth's stretching, casting, and emptying.
All three focus actions are feminine singular, sustaining one personified responder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accepted hearing, lordship, and due obligation on both sides of the focus; I infer that casting and relinquishment are the content of that obedience. The alternative is personified description of inevitable physics rather than willing compliance.

changed_reading.before: The earth is passively emptied by catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The earth actively answers its Lord by surrendering every interior holding and withholding nothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same meeting root soon names the human's arrival after labor. This reorients the focus casting: at least the human portion of what is inside is released forward into encounter, carrying the traces of its striving.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face arrival makes the focus casting directional toward an encounter.
Release frees the contents to continue beyond their former enclosure.
Toilsome work supplies the trajectory and accumulated history borne by the released human.
Explicit arrival face to face supplies the destination latent in the focus root.

structural_cues: The next new address after the earth sequence follows a human trajectory toward an encounter.
The focus object is unrestricted مَا, allowing persons among the released contents without reducing it to persons alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, strenuous human motion, and a repeated meeting root; I infer a handoff from terrestrial enclosure into encounter. The live alternative is only sonic-root cohesion, with no identity claim between all expelled contents and the addressed human.

changed_reading.before: The earth dumps inert contents outside itself.
changed_reading.after: The earth dispatches its occupants out of custody and into the encounter toward which their labor has already been moving.

context_deltas.mechanism: What is rendered outward becomes inventory fit for assignment and count. The opposed deliveries of a registered book show that externalization is followed by sorting, while accounting converts the focus clearance from a spatial event into an evidentiary one.

activation_trace.role: Casting produces the held material into an exterior forum where it can be handled.
Clearance from liability supplies the consequence of rendering up a complete deposit.
Giving supplies the post-disclosure transfer of evidentiary material to a recipient.
Enrollment in a register turns released contents into attributable record.
Counting and accounting supply the operation performed on the disclosed inventory.
The adverse delivery confirms that outward production precedes differentiated assignment.
The second registered placement supplies the negative branch of the sorting mechanism.

structural_cues: 84:7-10 repeat the giving of a book but bifurcate its placement and outcome.
The focus's total object and terminal clearance make incompleteness in the later inventory difficult to sustain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total production, registered delivery, and accounting; I infer that what the earth surrenders enters the evidentiary chain. The alternative is that earthly contents and personal books are parallel disclosures without material continuity.

changed_reading.after: The earth clears its charge by producing a complete inventory into the forum where records are assigned and reckoned.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later movement is repeatedly return, not disappearance. The focus release therefore reads as a gate in a return trajectory: former contents leave terrestrial containment and move toward relation and outcome, while the denied possibility of return is overturned.

activation_trace.role: Exterior encounter supplies a destination beyond mere expulsion.
Letting go opens the route by ending the earth's hold.
Return and destination supply forward motion after release.
A group of belonging supplies the relational endpoint for one branch of return.
Return and diminution expose the mistaken expectation that no reversal would occur.

structural_cues: A joyful return at 84:9 is later opposed to the subject's belief at 84:14 that he would never return.
The focus expulsion precedes both outcomes and can function as their shared release point.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terrestrial release and opposed claims about return; I infer that human occupants are included within the unrestricted focus object. A live alternative keeps the focus contents materially general and treats human return as only one downstream instance.

changed_reading.before: Expulsion is a terminal removal from place.
changed_reading.after: Expulsion is the opening of return: terrestrial custody ends so its occupants can reach their divergent relational outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah develops a geometry of storage, surfaces, and knowledge. A book is put behind a back, while what people pack inward remains known; the focus reverses that geometry by forcing the inside outside and leaving no concealing container intact.

activation_trace.role: Casting crosses the inside-outside boundary and makes the enclosed externally present.
Complete vacancy removes the last possible recess of concealment.
Placing something behind backs supplies a deliberate geometry of hiding.
The back as opposite of the belly supplies the bodily surface across which hidden and exposed exchange places.
Disclosure to a knower makes inward storage incapable of preserving secrecy.
Putting something into a vessel mirrors the focus enclosure and supplies the operation that the focus reverses.

structural_cues: The focus's مَا فِيهَا and 84:23's بِمَا يُوعُونَ echo unrestricted contents inside containers.
The back-positioned book gives the concealment pattern a visible bodily surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden placement, containment, knowledge, and focus emptying; I infer a macrocosm-microcosm analogy in which every store is made legible. The alternative keeps earth-storage and human inward storage as separate images joined only by judgment context.

changed_reading.before: The earth loses what occupied its interior.
changed_reading.after: The earth enacts the reversal of concealment: interior holdings cross the surface, become available to knowledge, and leave no secret remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later signs run in the inverse direction from the focus: night gathers a load and the moon reaches integrated fullness. The earth's unloading can therefore coexist with a cyclical reading in which cosmic vessels alternately collect, complete, release, and empty.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the release phase of the cycle.
Emptiness supplies the low-load endpoint opposite later fullness.
Night and darkness supply the temporal chamber in which gathering occurs.
Gathering dispersed things supplies the inverse operation to the focus discharge.
The moon supplies the visible body on which the completion phase appears.
Integrated fullness and evenness supply the completed-load pole opposite terrestrial vacancy.

structural_cues: The oath sequence places gathering at night immediately beside the moon's completion.
The focus itself pairs an active release verb with a state of emptiness, matching operation and endpoint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emptying, nocturnal gathering, and lunar completion; I infer inverse phases in one cosmic rhythm. The alternative is that the later oath signs mark temporal succession without describing a shared container cycle.

changed_reading.before: The earth's emptying is a single terminal collapse.
changed_reading.after: The earth occupies the release pole of a larger cosmic rhythm in which other chambers gather and reach fullness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Riding successive layers turns emptiness from an endpoint into an interface. The old containing state must release its load before that load can be borne into the next overlaid condition.

activation_trace.role: Casting ejects the load from the layer that formerly held it.
Passing away supplies the expiry of the old terrestrial phase.
One thing mounted over another supplies the transport geometry between strata.
State after state supplies the temporal succession that receives the discharged load.

structural_cues: 84:19 doubles طَبَقًا ... طَبَقٍ, making transition rather than a single destination explicit.
The focus has its own boundary syntax: action on contents followed by termination of the holder's occupied state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies discharge, expiry, mounting, and state after state; I infer that unloading is the threshold operation between layers. The alternative is that human stages proceed independently of the earth's earlier emptying.

changed_reading.before: Vacancy marks the end of the earth's event.
changed_reading.after: Vacancy marks a transfer boundary: the terrestrial layer releases its load so another state can bear it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth accepts and gives up its interior, whereas humans receive recitation but do not lower themselves, then cover and deny. The focus becomes a diagnostic mirror: the nonhuman subject relinquishes every holding; resistant humans preserve an inward refusal by concealment.

activation_trace.role: Outward casting supplies complete disclosure by the cosmic responder.
Letting go supplies the absence of resistance or retained claim.
Accepted hearing characterizes the earth's response and establishes one side of the contrast.
Audible recitation supplies the human opportunity to answer what is heard.
Lowering in submission supplies the response that the humans withhold.
Covering truth supplies the inverse of the earth's total exposure.
Contradiction of truth supplies the verbal form of retained resistance after hearing.

structural_cues: The opening cosmic subjects respond to their Lord, while 84:21 repeats إذا for humans who do not perform the expected response.
Exposure in the focus and covering at 84:22 create materially inverse actions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accepted cosmic hearing, human recitation, withheld submission, covering, and denial; I infer a deliberate contrast in response and disclosure. The alternative is a rhetorical juxtaposition that does not equate denial with retaining contents.

changed_reading.before: The earth's compliance is an isolated cosmic action.
changed_reading.after: The earth's empty openness indicts human resistance: matter surrenders its interior, while hearers still cover and withhold.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The vessel image is surprising because it comes from a form-distant noun branch of خ ل و, but it remains anchored in the focus's explicit container, cargo-like مَا فِيهَا, casting, and release, with later load-bearing support. Render it only as a material analogy for custody and unloading, never as the lexical translation of تَخَلَّتْ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus subject behaves as a bounded carrier: it holds an unrestricted load, puts that load out, and ends empty.

activation_trace.role: A vessel supplies the exploratory carrier image for the feminine containing subject.
Casting supplies the unloading operation performed on the vessel's contents.
Bearing a load supplies contextual support for treating containment as carriage rather than static occupancy.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a passive hollow from which matter falls.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the earth is a commissioned vessel that unloads its full cargo and relinquishes the manifest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The skinning image is cross-domain and late, yet it remains anchored in the focus's inside-to-outside syntax, the prior stretching of the earth, and a branch that removes a surface. Downstream prose should call this a tactile analogy of exposure, not claim that the focus verb means peeling or that the punishment address directly describes the earth.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مَا فِيهَا crosses from beneath a containing surface to the exterior, after which that containing body is bare.

activation_trace.role: Casting supplies the emergence of what had lain beneath the surface.
Bareness supplies the exposed body left after its interior is removed.
Lengthwise stretching supplies tension across the terrestrial surface before exposure.
Removal of an outer skin supplies the strange but coherent material analogy for forced interior exposure.

changed_reading.before: The earth empties like an ordinary container.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its stretched surface behaves like a removed skin, making what was under it exterior and leaving the body bare.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The temporal contrast is surprising because it activates the passing-away branch of تَخَلَّتْ rather than its immediate empty sense, but the focus sequence visibly ends a containing tenure and the closing phrase explicitly negates cutting or exhaustion. Preserve it as a contrast between regimes of duration, not as a claim that 84:4 itself names reward.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ends both occupation and the earth's holding role: contents are cast off and the occupied phase passes away.

activation_trace.role: Passing away supplies the expiry of the terrestrial container's occupied age.
The cast-off thing supplies the discarded remainder of the expired holding regime.
Negation and exception reverse the cutting predicate for the reward.
Cutting and diminishing until extension stops supply the duration that the closing negation excludes.

changed_reading.before: The emptying is only an instantaneous spatial event.
changed_reading.after: It also marks the cutoff of finite terrestrial holding, set against a reward whose extension is expressly not cut off.

strongest_changes: The repeated accepted-hearing formula turns total evacuation into the earth's active fulfillment of an owed response.
The encounter and accounting sequence turns discarded contents into a surrendered deposit entering meeting, registration, and reckoning.
The echo between what is inside the earth and what humans store inwardly turns emptying into a general reversal of concealment.
Nightly gathering, lunar completion, and successive layers preserve a second reading in which terrestrial vacancy is a transfer phase rather than pure termination.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several coexisting mechanisms because its two verbs encode both operation and aftermath: physical unloading, relinquished custody, clearance from charge, exposure of the hidden, and release into another stage. Context does not collapse these into one sense; it gives each a different causal continuation.
remaining_uncertainties: The unrestricted مَا can include humans, records, and material contents together, but the packet does not force one inventory or make every downstream object materially identical with what is expelled.
Responsive agency may be full personification or a grammar of inevitable compliance; both preserve the changed reading of nonresistance.
The gather-release cycle and layer-transfer models are coherent structural analogies, but their causal arrows are reader-supplied rather than explicit.
The vessel, peeled-surface, and finite-duration activations should remain marked as exploratory images rather than lexical substitutions.
